title: 掌子面攝影測量~Tunnel-face photogrammetry
focus: 以影像幾何、尺度控制與獨立檢核重建可追溯的掌子面模型~Reconstruct a traceable face model through image geometry, scale control and independent checks
summary: 本課聚焦以影像幾何、尺度控制與獨立檢核重建可追溯的掌子面模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on reconstruct a traceable face model through image geometry, scale control and independent checks. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 像素尺度與可見細節~Pixel scale and visible detail
units.title: 像素尺度與可見細節~Pixel scale and visible detail
units.mechanism: 地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。鏡頭模糊、影像雜訊及岩面紋理會限制可辨特徵，裂隙寬度低於有效分辨率時只能記為未解析。 假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。~Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry. Blur, noise and rock texture limit discernible features, and subresolution cracks must remain unresolved. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy. Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy.
units.verify: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。~Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.
units.failure: 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。~Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.
units.misconception: 增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。~Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄像素尺度與可見細節的資料來源與適用條件。用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pixel scale and visible detail. Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width.

units.anchor: 立體基線與深度~Stereo baseline and depth
units.title: 立體基線與深度~Stereo baseline and depth
units.mechanism: 不同視點的視差提供深度，基線過小使深度對像點誤差非常敏感，過大則減少共同可見紋理。拍攝幾何需要兼顧角度交會與遮擋，單純增加照片數不能補救全部來自同一位置。 假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。 低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。~Parallax from different viewpoints yields depth. A short baseline amplifies image error, while a long one loses common texture. Geometry must balance intersection angle and occlusion; many photographs from one position do not solve the problem. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm. Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm.
units.verify: 繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。~Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence.
units.failure: 低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。~Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence.
units.misconception: 所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。~Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄立體基線與深度的資料來源與適用條件。繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for stereo baseline and depth. Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors.

units.anchor: 相機校準與畸變~Camera calibration and distortion
units.title: 相機校準與畸變~Camera calibration and distortion
units.mechanism: 焦距、主點與鏡頭畸變共同控制射線方向，自校準需要足夠幾何多樣性才能辨識。全部照片近似共面或相機變焦，容易讓畸變與地表彎曲互相補償，形成看似低殘差的錯誤模型。 假設徑向畸變模型Δr=k1r³，r=1000 pixel、k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻²，Δr=1 pixel；單位須一致。 將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。~Focal length, principal point and distortion govern rays. Self-calibration needs geometric diversity; near-planar views or changing zoom can trade lens distortion against surface curvature, producing a wrong model with low residuals. For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent. Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief. Both can look accurate near controls yet deform the edges of the face model.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設徑向畸變模型Δr=k1r³，r=1000 pixel、k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻²，Δr=1 pixel；單位須一致。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent.
units.verify: 固定焦距與對焦狀態並保留原始EXIF，對照校準板及不同方位影像；檢查像面殘差是否呈徑向系統圖樣，獨立檢核仍有曲面偏差時，不以低重投影誤差直接驗收。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。~Fix and document focal and focus state with original EXIF, comparing calibration targets and varied views; inspect radial residual patterns and do not accept low reprojection error when independent checks retain systematic surface curvature. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief. Both can look accurate near controls yet deform the edges of the face model.
units.failure: 將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。~Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief. Both can look accurate near controls yet deform the edges of the face model.
units.misconception: 重投影誤差很低就保證鏡頭畸變和物面曲率已正確分離。~Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄相機校準與畸變的資料來源與適用條件。固定焦距與對焦狀態並保留原始EXIF，對照校準板及不同方位影像；檢查像面殘差是否呈徑向系統圖樣，獨立檢核仍有曲面偏差時，不以低重投影誤差直接驗收。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for camera calibration and distortion. Fix and document focal and focus state with original EXIF, comparing calibration targets and varied views; inspect radial residual patterns and do not accept low reprojection error when independent checks retain systematic surface curvature.

units.anchor: 尺度與控制點布置~Scale and control distribution
units.title: 尺度與控制點布置~Scale and control distribution
units.mechanism: 影像匹配本身只決定相對幾何，實際尺寸與方向需由可靠控制資訊固定。控制點若全擠在一角，模型其他區域仍可能傾斜或彎曲，應分布於可觀測範圍並保留獨立檢核點。 假設真實標距2.000 m被重建為1.990 m，尺度修正2.000/1.990=1.00503；仍不能修正局部翹曲。 只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。~Image matching determines relative geometry; reliable control establishes dimensions and orientation. Controls clustered in one corner leave other areas free to tilt or warp, so distribute them across the observable region and reserve independent checks. An assumed true distance 2.000 m reconstructed as 1.990 m requires scale factor 1.00503; that factor cannot correct local warping. One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model. Small average residuals can still conceal large local errors beyond the controlled region.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設真實標距2.000 m被重建為1.990 m，尺度修正2.000/1.990=1.00503；仍不能修正局部翹曲。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed true distance 2.000 m reconstructed as 1.990 m requires scale factor 1.00503; that factor cannot correct local warping.
units.verify: 以獨立測量取得控制坐標與不確定度，將控制及檢核分組並畫分布圖；驗收不只看控制殘差，也檢查遠離控制區的檢核點，缺乏覆蓋的區域須標示較低可信度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。~Survey control coordinates and uncertainties independently and map separate control and check groups; acceptance includes checkpoints away from controls, with lower confidence explicitly marked where spatial coverage is inadequate. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model. Small average residuals can still conceal large local errors beyond the controlled region.
units.failure: 只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。~One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model. Small average residuals can still conceal large local errors beyond the controlled region.
units.misconception: 一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。~One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄尺度與控制點布置的資料來源與適用條件。以獨立測量取得控制坐標與不確定度，將控制及檢核分組並畫分布圖；驗收不只看控制殘差，也檢查遠離控制區的檢核點，缺乏覆蓋的區域須標示較低可信度。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for scale and control distribution. Survey control coordinates and uncertainties independently and map separate control and check groups; acceptance includes checkpoints away from controls, with lower confidence explicitly marked where spatial coverage is inadequate.

units.anchor: 照明與濕壁反光~Lighting and wet-wall reflections
units.title: 照明與濕壁反光~Lighting and wet-wall reflections
units.mechanism: 攝影匹配假設同一紋理在不同視角仍可辨識，濕岩反光會隨視點移動而違反此假設。陰影、粉塵及過曝也會抹去特徵，需先評估影像品質再談高密度重建。 假設影像有200萬有效岩面像素，其中20萬過曝，過曝率10%；不能將其插值面視為直接量測。 反光亮點被當成固定特徵會產生漂浮點，濕壁暗帶也可能被誤判為裂隙；若平滑後直接匯出，錯誤來源會被漂亮表面掩蓋。~Matching assumes recognizable texture across viewpoints. Wet-rock highlights move with viewpoint and violate that assumption, while shadows, dust and saturation erase features. Assess source-image quality before requesting dense reconstruction. If an assumed 2000000 face pixels include 200000 saturated pixels, saturation is 10%; interpolated surfaces there are not direct measurements. Highlights treated as fixed features produce floating points, while wet dark bands mimic fractures. Smoothing before export can hide both artifacts behind a visually convincing surface.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設影像有200萬有效岩面像素，其中20萬過曝，過曝率10%；不能將其插值面視為直接量測。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 2000000 face pixels include 200000 saturated pixels, saturation is 10%; interpolated surfaces there are not direct measurements.
units.verify: 檢查直方圖、過曝遮罩與不同視角的反光位置，記錄照明與濕潤狀態；同一構造需在多張清晰影像確認，無紋理區保留空洞或低信心標記，不以自動補洞掩蓋缺資料。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：反光亮點被當成固定特徵會產生漂浮點，濕壁暗帶也可能被誤判為裂隙；若平滑後直接匯出，錯誤來源會被漂亮表面掩蓋。~Inspect histograms, saturation masks and viewpoint-dependent highlights and record lighting and moisture; confirm features in multiple clear images and retain gaps or low confidence in textureless zones rather than hiding missing evidence with hole filling. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Highlights treated as fixed features produce floating points, while wet dark bands mimic fractures. Smoothing before export can hide both artifacts behind a visually convincing surface.
units.failure: 反光亮點被當成固定特徵會產生漂浮點，濕壁暗帶也可能被誤判為裂隙；若平滑後直接匯出，錯誤來源會被漂亮表面掩蓋。~Highlights treated as fixed features produce floating points, while wet dark bands mimic fractures. Smoothing before export can hide both artifacts behind a visually convincing surface.
units.misconception: 濕壁上的反光亮點在所有視角都可以當固定紋理。~Wet-wall highlights can be treated as fixed texture in every viewing direction.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄照明與濕壁反光的資料來源與適用條件。檢查直方圖、過曝遮罩與不同視角的反光位置，記錄照明與濕潤狀態；同一構造需在多張清晰影像確認，無紋理區保留空洞或低信心標記，不以自動補洞掩蓋缺資料。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for lighting and wet-wall reflections. Inspect histograms, saturation masks and viewpoint-dependent highlights and record lighting and moisture; confirm features in multiple clear images and retain gaps or low confidence in textureless zones rather than hiding missing evidence with hole filling.

units.anchor: 遮擋與可見範圍~Occlusion and visible coverage
units.title: 遮擋與可見範圍~Occlusion and visible coverage
units.mechanism: 岩塊凸出會遮住其後凹面，多視點可改善卻不能保證全部可見。點雲孔洞應區分不可見、低紋理和處理失敗，因為缺測背面可能恰好控制塊體厚度與可動方向。 假設掌子面50 m²中實際重建42 m²，可見重建率84%；餘8 m²不能按平均表面直接補成穩定。 自動封閉網格可能把凹穴填平而低估超挖，也可能虛構塊體背面；模型封閉並不代表已取得完整幾何，現場判斷仍須知道不可見處。~Protruding blocks hide recesses; additional viewpoints help without guaranteeing complete coverage. Distinguish occlusion, poor texture and processing failure because an unseen back surface may control block thickness and movement direction. For an assumed 50 m² face with 42 m² reconstructed, coverage is 84%; the remaining 8 m² cannot be filled with an average surface and declared stable. Automatic mesh closure fills recesses and underestimates overbreak or invents block backs. A closed model therefore does not mean complete observed geometry, and engineering interpretation must retain visibility limits.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設掌子面50 m²中實際重建42 m²，可見重建率84%；餘8 m²不能按平均表面直接補成穩定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 50 m² face with 42 m² reconstructed, coverage is 84%; the remaining 8 m² cannot be filled with an average surface and declared stable.
units.verify: 以原始照片及視線圖查核點雲空洞，對不易看見的頂拱區單列覆蓋；只有在核准安全觀測位置取得補充資料，不能因追求模型完整而接近未支護掌子面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：自動封閉網格可能把凹穴填平而低估超挖，也可能虛構塊體背面；模型封閉並不代表已取得完整幾何，現場判斷仍須知道不可見處。~Review gaps against original images and visibility rays, reporting crown coverage separately; supplementary observations must use approved safe locations, never approaching an unsupported face merely to complete a model. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Automatic mesh closure fills recesses and underestimates overbreak or invents block backs. A closed model therefore does not mean complete observed geometry, and engineering interpretation must retain visibility limits.
units.failure: 自動封閉網格可能把凹穴填平而低估超挖，也可能虛構塊體背面；模型封閉並不代表已取得完整幾何，現場判斷仍須知道不可見處。~Automatic mesh closure fills recesses and underestimates overbreak or invents block backs. A closed model therefore does not mean complete observed geometry, and engineering interpretation must retain visibility limits.
units.misconception: 自動補成封閉網格就代表所有背面都已實際觀測。~Automatic mesh closure means every hidden back surface has actually been observed.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄遮擋與可見範圍的資料來源與適用條件。以原始照片及視線圖查核點雲空洞，對不易看見的頂拱區單列覆蓋；只有在核准安全觀測位置取得補充資料，不能因追求模型完整而接近未支護掌子面。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for occlusion and visible coverage. Review gaps against original images and visibility rays, reporting crown coverage separately; supplementary observations must use approved safe locations, never approaching an unsupported face merely to complete a model.

units.anchor: 重投影與獨立精度~Reprojection versus independent accuracy
units.title: 重投影與獨立精度~Reprojection versus independent accuracy
units.mechanism: 重投影殘差衡量影像方程內部一致，不能單獨代表物件坐標精度。錯誤尺度或共同控制偏差仍可有很小殘差，必須使用未參與最佳化的檢核資料評估外部準確性。 假設三個檢核誤差1、2、2 mm，RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm；不等於最大誤差。 把控制點同時當檢核點會誇大精度，模型又可能在少數點附近過擬合；若只報平均誤差，邊緣失真會被良好中心區大量資料沖淡。~Reprojection residual measures internal image consistency, not object-space accuracy. Wrong scale or common control bias can coexist with small residuals, requiring independent observations excluded from optimization to assess external accuracy. For assumed checkpoint errors 1,2 and 2 mm, RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm; this is not the maximum error. Reusing controls as checkpoints exaggerates accuracy and can hide local overfitting. Reporting only an average also dilutes distorted edges with numerous good observations from the center of the model.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個檢核誤差1、2、2 mm，RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm；不等於最大誤差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed checkpoint errors 1,2 and 2 mm, RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm; this is not the maximum error.
units.verify: 分別報告像素殘差、三維檢核誤差與最大局部偏差，註明檢核點是否獨立；將模型與全測站或雷射掃描在同一坐標比較，系統性方向誤差需先查基準再談平均精度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把控制點同時當檢核點會誇大精度，模型又可能在少數點附近過擬合；若只報平均誤差，邊緣失真會被良好中心區大量資料沖淡。~Report pixel residual, three-dimensional checkpoint error and maximum local discrepancy separately with checkpoint independence; compare surveying or laser scanning in a common frame and investigate systematic directional error before claiming average accuracy. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Reusing controls as checkpoints exaggerates accuracy and can hide local overfitting. Reporting only an average also dilutes distorted edges with numerous good observations from the center of the model.
units.failure: 把控制點同時當檢核點會誇大精度，模型又可能在少數點附近過擬合；若只報平均誤差，邊緣失真會被良好中心區大量資料沖淡。~Reusing controls as checkpoints exaggerates accuracy and can hide local overfitting. Reporting only an average also dilutes distorted edges with numerous good observations from the center of the model.
units.misconception: 控制點也可以同時當作獨立精度檢核點。~Control points can simultaneously serve as independent accuracy checkpoints.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄重投影與獨立精度的資料來源與適用條件。分別報告像素殘差、三維檢核誤差與最大局部偏差，註明檢核點是否獨立；將模型與全測站或雷射掃描在同一坐標比較，系統性方向誤差需先查基準再談平均精度。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for reprojection versus independent accuracy. Report pixel residual, three-dimensional checkpoint error and maximum local discrepancy separately with checkpoint independence; compare surveying or laser scanning in a common frame and investigate systematic directional error before claiming average accuracy.

units.anchor: 節理平面與法向~Joint planes and normals
units.title: 節理平面與法向~Joint planes and normals
units.mechanism: 點雲擬合平面可取得節理方向，但選取區域混入多個面時，最小平方只得到折衷面。粗糙度與測量噪音都進入殘差，應檢查法向穩定性及實際地質連續性。 假設平面法向量(0,0.6,0.8)已單位化，與鉛直夾角acos0.8=36.87°，即此平面傾角。 跨越兩面擬合會生成現場不存在的中間傾角，細密點群偏重一側又會支配結果；由此做楔體分析可能漏掉真正交線或創造假楔體。~A fitted plane yields joint orientation, but combining several surfaces produces a least-squares compromise. Roughness and measurement noise both contribute residuals, requiring normal stability checks and geological evidence of continuity. For assumed unit normal (0,0.6,0.8), angle to vertical acos0.8=36.87° gives the plane dip under this convention. Fitting across two planes invents an intermediate dip, and dense points on one side bias the result. Wedge analysis may then miss the true intersection or manufacture a nonexistent block.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平面法向量(0,0.6,0.8)已單位化，與鉛直夾角acos0.8=36.87°，即此平面傾角。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed unit normal (0,0.6,0.8), angle to vertical acos0.8=36.87° gives the plane dip under this convention.
units.verify: 改變選面範圍與抽樣密度檢查法向是否穩定，並以人工地質描線核對是否同一節理；法向需轉到工程坐標且保留正反向約定，不能將表面法向誤作傾向方位。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：跨越兩面擬合會生成現場不存在的中間傾角，細密點群偏重一側又會支配結果；由此做楔體分析可能漏掉真正交線或創造假楔體。~Vary selection extent and sampling density to test normal stability and compare geological traces; transform to engineering coordinates with a stated sign convention, avoiding confusion between the normal vector and dip-direction azimuth. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Fitting across two planes invents an intermediate dip, and dense points on one side bias the result. Wedge analysis may then miss the true intersection or manufacture a nonexistent block.
units.failure: 跨越兩面擬合會生成現場不存在的中間傾角，細密點群偏重一側又會支配結果；由此做楔體分析可能漏掉真正交線或創造假楔體。~Fitting across two planes invents an intermediate dip, and dense points on one side bias the result. Wedge analysis may then miss the true intersection or manufacture a nonexistent block.
units.misconception: 跨越兩個節理面擬合的平均平面就是現場的真實節理。~The average plane fitted across two joints is a real joint surface in the ground.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄節理平面與法向的資料來源與適用條件。改變選面範圍與抽樣密度檢查法向是否穩定，並以人工地質描線核對是否同一節理；法向需轉到工程坐標且保留正反向約定，不能將表面法向誤作傾向方位。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for joint planes and normals. Vary selection extent and sampling density to test normal stability and compare geological traces; transform to engineering coordinates with a stated sign convention, avoiding confusion between the normal vector and dip-direction azimuth.

units.anchor: 重複測量與變化偵測~Repeat surveys and change detection
units.title: 重複測量與變化偵測~Repeat surveys and change detection
units.mechanism: 兩次點雲差值同時包含真實變化與配準誤差，不能把每個非零距離當作岩塊移動。表面法向方向的比較與共同穩定區很重要，配準若包含變形面會把真位移吸收。 假設兩期表面標準不確定各2 mm且獨立，差值u=2.83 mm；約95%正態尺度1.96u=5.54 mm。 使用全部面點最佳擬合會把整片岩面移動抵消，照明造成的重建差異又可能假裝剝落；沒有共視遮罩時缺測區會產生巨大的假變化。~Cloud differences combine real change and registration error, so nonzero distance alone does not prove movement. Compare along suitable surface normals using stable areas; registration against deforming surfaces can absorb the true displacement. Assume independent surface uncertainties of 2 mm per epoch; difference u=2.83 mm and an approximate 95% normal scale is 1.96u=5.54 mm. Best-fitting all face points can cancel whole-surface movement, while lighting-driven reconstruction differences mimic spalling. Missing common-visibility masks create large false changes where one epoch has no observations.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩期表面標準不確定各2 mm且獨立，差值u=2.83 mm；約95%正態尺度1.96u=5.54 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent surface uncertainties of 2 mm per epoch; difference u=2.83 mm and an approximate 95% normal scale is 1.96u=5.54 mm.
units.verify: 以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：使用全部面點最佳擬合會把整片岩面移動抵消，照明造成的重建差異又可能假裝剝落；沒有共視遮罩時缺測區會產生巨大的假變化。~Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas; combine roughness with uncertainty to flag detectable change, avoiding the illustrative 95% factor under correlated or nonnormal errors. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Best-fitting all face points can cancel whole-surface movement, while lighting-driven reconstruction differences mimic spalling. Missing common-visibility masks create large false changes where one epoch has no observations.
units.failure: 使用全部面點最佳擬合會把整片岩面移動抵消，照明造成的重建差異又可能假裝剝落；沒有共視遮罩時缺測區會產生巨大的假變化。~Best-fitting all face points can cancel whole-surface movement, while lighting-driven reconstruction differences mimic spalling. Missing common-visibility masks create large false changes where one epoch has no observations.
units.misconception: 把兩期全部點雲最佳配準就不會消除任何真實位移。~Best-fitting all points across two epochs cannot remove genuine movement.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄重複測量與變化偵測的資料來源與適用條件。以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for repeat surveys and change detection. Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas; combine roughness with uncertainty to flag detectable change, avoiding the illustrative 95% factor under correlated or nonnormal errors.

units.anchor: 模型證據與安全交接~Model evidence and safe handover
units.title: 模型證據與安全交接~Model evidence and safe handover
units.mechanism: 掌子面模型是地質記錄工具，不能替代現場支護與穩定判斷。交接須包含影像、坐標、檢核、可見範圍和拍攝時刻，讓後續設計知道模型對應哪次開挖及哪些部分只是插值。 假設10項交接資料有9項齊備，完整率90%；缺少坐標基準這1項仍可使整個模型不可整合。 只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。~A face model documents geology rather than replacing support or stability decisions. Handover includes images, datum, checks, visibility and capture time so designers know the excavation round represented and which surfaces are interpolated. If 9 of an assumed 10 handover items are complete, completeness is 90%; one missing coordinate datum can still make the entire model unusable for integration. A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability. Mismatched chainage may direct support interpretation to the previous excavation round, and visual realism cannot compensate for the missing evidence chain.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10項交接資料有9項齊備，完整率90%；缺少坐標基準這1項仍可使整個模型不可整合。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 handover items are complete, completeness is 90%; one missing coordinate datum can still make the entire model unusable for integration.
units.verify: 從報告中的一條節理追查至原照片與選點，抽驗坐標及拍攝里程；測量與地質主管共同確認可用範圍，影像可取得不代表允許接近掌子面，所有補拍遵守核准現場觀測程序。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。~Trace a reported joint to original images and picks and audit coordinates and capture chainage; survey and geology leads jointly approve use limits, while supplementary photography remains subject to approved site observation procedures. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability. Mismatched chainage may direct support interpretation to the previous excavation round, and visual realism cannot compensate for the missing evidence chain.
units.failure: 只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。~A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability. Mismatched chainage may direct support interpretation to the previous excavation round, and visual realism cannot compensate for the missing evidence chain.
units.misconception: 彩色模型看起來逼真，就足以代替原始照片與坐標紀錄。~A realistic colored model adequately replaces original photographs and coordinate records.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄模型證據與安全交接的資料來源與適用條件。從報告中的一條節理追查至原照片與選點，抽驗坐標及拍攝里程；測量與地質主管共同確認可用範圍，影像可取得不代表允許接近掌子面，所有補拍遵守核准現場觀測程序。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for model evidence and safe handover. Trace a reported joint to original images and picks and audit coordinates and capture chainage; survey and geology leads jointly approve use limits, while supplementary photography remains subject to approved site observation procedures.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以影像幾何、尺度控制與獨立檢核重建可追溯的掌子面模型需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why reconstruct a traceable face model through image geometry, scale control and independent checks requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy.
教學量化備忘：假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm.

教學量化備忘：假設徑向畸變模型Δr=k1r³，r=1000 pixel、k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻²，Δr=1 pixel；單位須一致。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent.

教學量化備忘：假設真實標距2.000 m被重建為1.990 m，尺度修正2.000/1.990=1.00503；仍不能修正局部翹曲。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed true distance 2.000 m reconstructed as 1.990 m requires scale factor 1.00503; that factor cannot correct local warping.

教學量化備忘：假設影像有200萬有效岩面像素，其中20萬過曝，過曝率10%；不能將其插值面視為直接量測。~Teaching quantitative note: If an assumed 2000000 face pixels include 200000 saturated pixels, saturation is 10%; interpolated surfaces there are not direct measurements.

教學量化備忘：假設掌子面50 m²中實際重建42 m²，可見重建率84%；餘8 m²不能按平均表面直接補成穩定。~Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed 50 m² face with 42 m² reconstructed, coverage is 84%; the remaining 8 m² cannot be filled with an average surface and declared stable.
